catalogue.comment:
MANUFACTORUM IMPERIUM LIBRARY V1
Reusable cross-faction vehicle library for the Adeptus Mechanicus Manufactorum Imperium rule. V1 contains every Vehicle unit currently implemented in Astra Militarum 3.3.3 Rev18. Space Marine Arsenal vehicles are intentionally not implemented yet. Unit trees, costs, loadouts, Rare semantics, Leader Capacity markers, and Other soft-copy markers are preserved from their source catalogue.

LIBRARY V2 — GAME SYSTEM REV14
Retargeted to Warhammer 40k Reforged Game System Rev14, which now owns the visible Space Marines Vehicles and Astra Militarum Vehicles presentation categories. No unit trees, costs, loadouts, IDs, or imported Astra Militarum semantics changed.

LIBRARY V3 POLISH SYNC
Mirrored the Astra Militarum REV19 presentation polish across all eleven imported vehicle trees: direct Loadout headings are now Loadout Options; Tank Commander, Chimera, Taurox, Leman Russ Battle Tank, Hellhound, Basilisk, Wyvern, and Manticore use the same explicit model-header IDs as the source catalogue; Basilisk, Wyvern, and Manticore suppress the redundant Hull Weapon group label; Chimera and Taurox use Storm Bolter spelling; and Tank Commander uses the standardized Rare error wording. Unit IDs, existing loadout IDs, costs, categories, Rare semantics, Leader Capacity markers, Other soft-copy markers, and Manufactorum-specific category presentation remain unchanged.

LIBRARY V4 RETROSPECTIVE POLISH SYNC
Mirrored the final Astra Militarum REV20 vehicle presentation cleanup across all eleven imported vehicle trees. Redundant one-item Paid Wargear wrappers are suppressed where the equipment name already identifies the choice; vehicle multi-option accessory/pintle groups use Pintle Weapons; the Taurox Twin Autocannon double wrapper is suppressed; and existing self-identifying hull, sponson, and coaxial equipment names remain free of redundant slot labels. The historical V1 provenance notes remain unchanged. All pre-existing IDs, unit names, points, costs, categories, Rare semantics, Leader Capacity markers, Other soft-copy markers, Manufactorum source-switch behavior, and imported Astra Militarum rules semantics remain unchanged.

LIBRARY V5 — GAME SYSTEM REV17
Retargeted the Manufactorum Imperium shared vehicle library to Warhammer 40k Reforged Game System revision 17. This library contains only shared Astra Militarum Vehicle/Other units, so no Troop copy-cost families or Troop semantic markers are added here. Existing Other soft-copy markers, Additional Copy Costs rule links, Rare semantics, Leader Capacity markers, shared unit IDs, costs, loadouts, and Manufactorum presentation semantics remain unchanged.
